objectiveText: Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.
The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.

objectiveText: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.
Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.
Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.
Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.

Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.
